steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each consultation meeting is placed by its date in the process.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Point raised with no response recorded
findings.fix: Record the response before the next meeting

findings.title: Attendee named where a role is needed
findings.fix: Record the role, not the name

outcome.notChecked: Whether the consultation was adequate in law.

pros: Checks a meeting with no date, a point raised with no response recorded, and an attendee named where a role is needed.
cons: Not checked: Whether the consultation was adequate in law.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-consultation-log skill on the records for this review.
